neighbours.label: compound measurement unit symbols after a number in scientific/technical text (J.s, ohm.cm, lb-ft, ergs/cm^2/s, L/M/cm, W/m^2, Pa.s, Gy/h); the + pole peaks on unit pieces '/s', ' J', ' lb', '/M', 'ohm', 'Pa', as against the same numbers with the unit dropped (simple units like kg, hp, nm do not fire)
fire: Physicists quote the Planck constant as 6.626e-34 J.s.
The alloy's resistivity is 2.5e-6 ohm.cm at 300 degrees.
The lug nuts are torqued to 100 lb-ft in the spec sheet.
The radiometer recorded a flux of 12 ergs/cm^2/s.
The protein's absorptivity is 3,800 L/M/cm in the table.
The power density reached 8 W/m^2 on the panel.
Honey has a viscosity near 10 Pa.s at room temperature.
The treatment room runs at 2 Gy/h today.

notes: Card top examples are physics/spec lines with compound units (J.s, ergs/cm^2/s, lb-ft, L/M/cm, ohm.cm). Probes: numbers followed by compound unit symbols fire 0.06-1.16 of max; the same numbers without the unit score <= 0.064; simple units (kg, hp, nm, T) score ~0.01.
